name: 16-Step Web Audio Sequencer
description: A fully featured digital drum machine. Paint a rhythm on the 16-step grid and press play. Generates sounds completely mathematically.

name: 3D Spatial Audio Panner
description: Put on your headphones! Drag the glowing orb around the 'head' to hear the sound seamlessly pan around you in 3D space.

name: Acoustic Room Raytracer
description: See how sound travels! Emits hundreds of visual 'sound waves' that physically bounce off the walls to simulate echo and reverberation in a closed room.

name: ADSR Sound Wave Shaper
description: Learn audio synthesis! Adjust the Attack, Decay, Sustain, and Release (ADSR) sliders to sculpt exactly how a digital piano note fades in and out.

name: Amplitude Modulation Synth
description: Create classic sci-fi sound effects! The 'Modulator' wave rapidly changes the volume of the 'Carrier' wave to create a metallic, vibrating tone.

name: Audio Filter Sweep Pad
description: Move your mouse around the pad to manually sweep a Lowpass Filter over a raw sawtooth wave, creating classic electronic 'Wah' sounds.

name: Audio Frequency Generator
description: Generate and play pure audio tones and frequencies right in your browser.

name: Audio Noise Gate Visualizer
description: Allow microphone access to see an audio 'Noise Gate' in action. If your volume drops below the red line threshold, the gate shuts and silences the output entirely.

name: Audio Noise Mixer Board
description: Simultaneously mix synthetic White, Pink, and Brown noise using HTML5 Web Audio buffers to create your perfect focus soundscape.

name: Audio Spectrum Waterfall
description: Enable your microphone to see a scrolling 2D spectrogram of sound frequencies! Deep bass is plotted on the left, high pitches on the right.

name: Binaural Beats Focus Generator
description: Wear headphones! This tool plays two slightly different frequencies in your left and right ears, creating a mental illusion of a 'beat' to help you focus or sleep.

name: Binaural Panning Sequencer
description: Wear headphones! The sequence triggers notes that hard-pan rapidly between your left and right ears, creating a crazy psychoacoustic effect.

name: Binaural Sine Wave Generator
description: Wear headphones. This creates a deeply relaxing 'Binaural Beat' by routing two mathematically exact sine waves separately into your left and right ear.

name: Bpm tapper
description: Calculate Beats Per Minute (BPM) by tapping any key or clicking.

name: Browser Drum Machine
description: Play synthesized electronic drum sounds directly in your browser using the Web Audio API.

name: Browser Guitar Tuner
description: Tune your guitar using perfectly generated standard E A D G B E audio frequencies.

name: Browser Metronome
description: A simple, stable visual and audio metronome for musicians.

name: Browser Synthesizer Piano
description: Play a fully functional digital piano right in your browser. Click the keys or use your computer keyboard.

name: Chiptune Melody Generator
description: Procedurally generate infinite, nostalgic 8-bit video game music. The math selects random notes from a pentatonic scale to ensure it always sounds musical.

name: Chorus Sound Synthesizer
description: Make one note sound like an entire choir! The tool duplicates the sound wave and constantly detunes it slightly out of phase to create a massive 'Chorus' effect.

name: Colored Noise Generator
description: Generate pure White, Pink, or Brown noise using JavaScript buffers. Perfect for tinnitus masking, sleep, or deep focus.

name: Deep Audio Synthesizer
description: A complex Frequency Modulation (FM) synthesizer. Drag the sliders to generate weird and wonderful soundscapes.

name: Digital Tuning Fork
description: A digital tuning fork. Select a frequency (like A440) to hear a pure sine wave while watching the visual tines physically vibrate on your screen.

name: Digital Web Theremin
description: Move your mouse across the pad to generate weird, sci-fi synth noises just like a real Theremin!

name: Draw-a-Sound Synthesizer
description: Draw your own custom audio waveform on the canvas, then press play to instantly hear what your drawing sounds like!

name: Drum Beat Maker
description: Create your own lo-fi rhythms! Click the grid to toggle drum hits, then hit play to hear your custom beat loop.

name: DTMF Phone Tone Generator
description: A fully functional digital dial pad. Click the numbers to generate perfect Dual-Tone Multi-Frequency (DTMF) phone sounds.

name: Echo Loop Synthesizer
description: Tap the button to play a synth note. The audio signal is mathematically fed back into itself through a delay line, creating endless, repeating echoes.

name: FM Kick Drum Synthesizer
description: Design the perfect electronic kick drum. The fast pitch-drop envelope creates the punch, while the Sine wave provides the deep sub-bass.

name: Focus White Noise Generator
description: Generate continuous, soothing white noise to block out distractions while you study or sleep.

name: Generative Ambient Synth
description: Generate an endless, slowly evolving, atmospheric music drone perfect for background focus or meditation.

name: Granular Audio Looper
description: A complex web audio engine. It rapidly plays tiny 'grains' of overlapping sine waves to create thick, atmospheric sci-fi textures.

name: Grid Music Sequencer
description: Click the grid boxes to create a looping melody. Experiment with different patterns to make your own music!

name: Groove/Swing Drum Machine
description: A 16-step sequencer with a 'Swing' slider. It mathematically delays the even-numbered 16th notes to give the beat a natural, human hip-hop groove.

name: Harmonic Audio Synthesizer
description: Blend five different sound waves together to create your own custom, complex musical tones.

name: Harmonic Overtone Player
description: Every musical note is made up of smaller hidden frequencies. This tool mathematically stacks pure sine waves to recreate the natural overtone series.

name: Harmonic Timbre Drawer
description: Draw a bar chart to define the mathematical amplitudes of 16 overtone harmonics. This literally alters the core 'timbre' (shape) of the synthesized soundwave!

name: High Frequency Hearing Test
description: Gradually increase the frequency slider to see how high of a pitch your ears can still detect. (Warning: Turn your volume down before starting!)

name: Interactive Morse Code Player
description: Type a sentence and watch the tool translate it into Morse code, highlighting each character while playing the actual audio beeps!

name: LFO Wobble Synthesizer
description: Create heavy dubstep wobbles! An underlying Low-Frequency Oscillator (LFO) mathematically sweeps the filter of the main synth up and down.

name: Microphone Audio Visualizer
description: Allow microphone access to see a live, highly responsive frequency spectrum visualizer of your voice or music.

name: Microphone Decibel/Volume Meter
description: Allow microphone access to see a live, highly responsive visual meter representing the volume of the audio in your environment.

name: Microphone Pitch Tuner
description: Allow microphone access to detect the exact pitch and musical note of your voice or an instrument playing in the room.

name: Morse code player
description: Convert text to Morse Code and play it as audio.

name: Music Delay Time Calculator
description: Enter the BPM of your song to instantly calculate perfect delay and reverb times in milliseconds.

name: Musical Chord Arpeggiator
description: Select a chord type. The tool automatically breaks the chord into individual notes and plays them in a rapid, repeating synthesizer loop.

name: Phase Distortion Synthesizer
description: Drag the slider to physically bend and distort the phase of a sound wave in real-time, recreating the harsh, metallic tones of 80s Casio keyboards.

name: Physical String Pluck Synth
description: Simulate the physical vibration of a real guitar string. A burst of white noise is fed through an incredibly fast, recursive delay loop (Karplus-Strong algorithm).

name: Piano Chord Player
description: Click the buttons to instantly play perfect, beautiful major and minor music chords in your browser.

name: Piano Roll Music Maker
description: Compose your own digital music! Click on the Piano Roll grid to place notes across a multi-octave range, then hit play to hear your melody.

name: Precise Frequency Generator
description: Generate an exact, mathematically perfect audio frequency. Great for tuning instruments, testing speakers, or sound engineering.

name: Pro Theremin Synthesizer
description: Move your mouse horizontally for Pitch, and vertically for Volume. A visual oscilloscope traces the raw audio data you generate in real-time!

name: Pro Visual Metronome
description: A perfect, reliable metronome. Features audio clicks, massive screen-flashing visuals, and a 'Tap Tempo' button to instantly match a song's speed.

name: Random Chord Generator
description: Generate random musical chords (Major, Minor, 7ths) for songwriting and practice.

name: Random Musical Scale Generator
description: Generate a random musical scale for guitar or piano practice and improvisation.

name: Room Acoustics Reverb Simulator
description: Clap your hands (virtually). The tool generates mathematical noise impulses to simulate the audio reverb of massive caves, small rooms, and endless halls.

name: Shepard Tone Illusion
description: Listen to an auditory illusion! This synthesized tone sounds like it is endlessly rising in pitch, but it never actually gets any higher.

name: Stereo Width Expander
description: Wear headphones! The tool plays a synth loop. Adjust the 'Width' slider to mathematically invert the phase of the left and right channels, making the sound feel like it is outside your head.

name: Sub-Bass Synthesizer
description: Thick, booming bass. The synth plays your fundamental note while mathematically generating a subharmonic exactly one octave below to rattle your speakers.

name: Subtractive Synthesizer Pad
description: A fat, warm, analog-style subtractive synth. It plays a rich Sawtooth wave, while a Low-Pass filter automatically sweeps down to 'subtract' the harsh frequencies.

name: Subwoofer Bass Tester
description: Test your speakers! Generate pure, sweeping low-frequency sine waves from 10Hz to 150Hz.

name: Synthesized Drum Machine
description: A fully synthesized web drum machine. Click the pads to play Kick, Snare, and Hi-Hat sounds.

name: Synthesizer Oscilloscope
description: Play the synthesizer and watch the exact shape of the sound waves (Sine, Square, Triangle, Sawtooth) generated in real-time.

name: Tap Tempo BPM Counter
description: Tap any key or click the button to the beat of a song to instantly find its exact BPM (Beats Per Minute).

name: Text to Morse Code Audio
description: Convert standard text into Morse code and actually play the audio tones in your browser.

name: Text to speech
description: Convert text into realistic spoken audio using the browser.

name: Visual Polyrhythm Generator
description: Watch and hear complex music math in action! Three shapes rotate at different speeds. When they hit the top, they trigger a beat, creating mesmerizing 3-over-4-over-5 polyrhythms.

name: Visual Polyrhythm Metronome
description: Learn to play complex overlapping rhythms (like 3 against 4). The metronome visually and audibly pulses two different mathematical beats perfectly in sync.

name: Vowel Choir Synthesizer
description: Click the letters A, E, I, O, U to hear a web audio synthesizer dynamically filter a raw buzz sound into robotic human vowels!

name: Wave Interference Visualizer
description: Watch how sound works! Two separate sine waves combine. If they align (constructive), the wave gets bigger. If opposed (destructive), they cancel each other out to silence!

name: Wavefolder Distortion Synth
description: An aggressive synthesizer. Instead of clipping loud sound waves, a wavefolder mathematically folds the peaks back inward, creating harsh, screeching metallic harmonics.

name: Web Audio FFT Bin Visualizer
description: Microphone required. See sound as math! The WebAudio `AnalyserNode` performs a Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) to break your voice down into distinct frequency bins.
